Model Context Protocol

MCP Server

Plug any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude, ChatGPT's MCP integrations, custom agents) into EVE-KILL. 45 purpose-built tools cover killmail lookup, character intel, corp/alliance analytics, battle reports, Memgraph-backed relationship graphs, and route danger assessment. No API key. No auth. JSON-RPC over streamable HTTP.

45 toolshttps://eve-kill.com/api

Connect an AI client

MCP clients that speak streamable-HTTP can add EVE-KILL as a server. Endpoint: https://eve-kill.com/api/mcp (POST JSON-RPC, optional SSE on GET). Rate limit: 20 req/s per IP.

Claude Code / ChatGPT / native HTTP clients
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "evekill": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://eve-kill.com/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}

Or from the CLI: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http evekill https://eve-kill.com/api/mcp

Claude Desktop (via mcp-remote)
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "evekill": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://eve-kill.com/api/mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Desktop uses the mcp-remote adapter to connect over HTTP. Edit the Desktop config file, then restart it.

Raw cURL (sanity-check the server)
curl -s -X POST https://eve-kill.com/api/mcp \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":{"query":"Jita"}}}'
Building an agent? Point it at /mcp.txt — a machine-readable usage guide tailored for AI models.MCP spec ↗

Discovery

search requires query

Search EVE Online entities by name or ticker across characters, corporations, alliances, ships, items, systems, regions, constellations, and factions. Use this first when an entity is only known by name.

⌄

Arguments

limit
integer

Maximum number of matches to return.

query required
string

Name or ticker to search for. Three or more characters enable fuzzy matching.

type
null | string

Restrict results to one entity type.
